guide.configureRootsEnableFileManagementAndCho: Configure roots, enable file management and choose comic locations
guide.aLibraryIsAMountedServerRoot: A library is a mounted server root
guide.lumaReadsExistingMediaInDirectoriesMount: Luma reads existing media in directories mounted into the server. A library is a root directory with a stable ID and name; albums are folders inside a library. The paths in Luma configuration are container paths, not host paths. Adding a disk or share requires mounting it and configuring another library, then restarting. The browser cannot access arbitrary paths on your computer.
guide.useConsecutiveConfigurationIndexesStarti: Use consecutive configuration indexes starting at 0, but keep each library ID stable and unique across upgrades. Open a library and choose initial indexing options. Scanning reads originals to build the index; normal indexed browsing uses SQLite and cache. Read-only media is sufficient for browsing, tagging, video and captions.
guide.dockerEnvironmentThenSettingsGeneralFile: Docker environment, then Settings → General → File management
guide.turnOnEnableFileManagementInSettingsGene: Turn on Enable file management in Settings → General → File management. The switch is saved for this server and survives refresh/restart. Luma__Files__Enabled supplies the initial environment default; saved in-app choices take priority. There is no administrator password or token. Each editable library also needs Writable=true and a :rw media mount. Flick, Panels and comic metadata work independently of this switch.
guide.startupBannerSettingsGeneralFileManageme: Startup banner / Settings → General → File management
guide.lumaChecksWriteAccessAtStartupAndWhenEna: Luma checks write access at startup and when enabling file management. Read-only roots and failed checks disable uploads, folder creation, moves, recycling, restore and deletion for that library. Browsing, captions and database tags keep working. Correct the mount or permissions and choose Check media mounts to restore write actions. The button shows Checking while it runs, then reports how many libraries are writable and the result for each library; it does not change Docker mounts or library configuration. The tiny diagnostic probe uses excluded staging, never an original file. A brief floating notice dismisses automatically; detailed mount information stays in Settings. Dismiss hides the notice for this server boot.
guide.theEmptyStartPageHasAddComicLocationIt: The empty start page has Add comic location. It and Comic locations always open the same dialog. Choose one or more configured libraries and relative folders. Choose folder opens a browser of the mounted library, including unindexed comic folders. Search folders finds indexed folder names and matching visible folders; select the result, then Use this folder. Up one folder and Library root help you navigate without typing. An empty path selects the root. Save locations and scan queues recursive archive discovery. A discovery message shows processed books; the Background jobs icon in the Panels header opens progress, failures and retry controls. Books and folders refresh as discovery runs. Ordinary photo folders become comics only if you explicitly enable Treat folders containing images as comics. This setup works with read-only media and does not require file management to be enabled.
guide.checkedByDefaultForEachComicLocationIncl: Checked by default for each comic location, including existing locations when upgrading to beta.3. The location and all subfolders are skipped by Gallery discovery and hidden from Gallery results, folder browsing, exclusive tag collections/suggestions and XMP export. Already-indexed media IDs and tags remain stored, so there is no duplicate import or destructive move. Uncheck to restore Gallery visibility; rescan the library to discover images added while excluded. Manually hidden folders stay hidden independently. Overlapping comic locations share the same library/path identity; exclusion applies if any containing location has it checked. Separate server library roots must remain non-overlapping. Luma__Panels__Sources__0__ExcludeFromGallery supplies the initial environment default; saved locations take priority.
guide.thePanelsStartPageShowsUpToFiveRecently: The Panels start page shows up to five recently read unfinished books in a horizontally scrollable Continue reading row with page indicators, followed by your saved locations. Folder cards reuse Gallery smart covers and follow the album-cover style in Settings. Open a location to browse its immediate subfolders and books, such as Base → Manga → DBZ. Up moves to the parent folder; Bookshelf returns to your saved locations. Comic locations lets you add, replace, remove or rescan sources. Books outside the selected locations are hidden; stored metadata and reading progress are preserved for re-adding a location. Search suggests comic titles; Enter searches titles, authors and series across the current library, or all locations from the start page. Filters include series, reading status, favourites and comic tag. Details includes the shared tag editor; comic-only tags do not appear in Gallery collections or suggestions.
guide.galleryIsAlwaysAvailableEnableOrHideFlic: Gallery is always available. Enable or hide Flick and Panels, both on by default, for everyone on this server. In-app choices are saved in SQLite and override Luma__Ui__FlickEnabled and Luma__Ui__PanelsEnabled environment defaults. Settings opens at the originating app’s section and Back returns to that app. The group headings are General, Gallery, Flick and Panels; there is no floating section-navigation bar. Search and Filters are hidden on Settings. Settings is the gear in the top header; bottom navigation contains Library and Collections only.
guide.backUpSQLiteAndOriginalStagingTrashMedia: Back up SQLite and original/staging/trash media at one stopped-service checkpoint before upgrading. Older versions reject newer schemas; rollback requires the matching old image and pre-upgrade backup.
guide.switchApplicationsManageWritableLibrarie: Switch applications, manage writable libraries, upload and recover files
guide.clickTheLumaLogoToChooseGalleryFlickOr: Click the Luma logo to choose Gallery, Flick or Panels. Its small superscript icon identifies the active app. Each application keeps its own search and filters. Flick and Panels have their own navigation; use the logo to return to Gallery, even when a feed is empty.
guide.searchComicTitlesOrSeriesFilterBySeriesC: Search comic titles or series, filter by series, comic tag, reading status or favourites, and open a comic to resume reading. On first visit, Comic locations lets you select libraries and folders for recursive discovery. Saved locations open as a bookshelf on later visits; change or rescan them from Comic locations independently of file management. Details edits title, series, author, description, favourite and cover page. The Reader settings icon opens a popup for single or continuous pages, reading direction, fit, zoom and fullscreen. Pinch zoom and drag to pan in the reader; continuous pages touch without artificial gaps and remain virtualized for large books. The compact page counter opens Go to page with a number field and slider; previous/next arrows, swipe and keyboard navigation stay available. Page changes save automatically; Exit reader waits for the latest checkpoint. Reopening fetches saved progress before rendering the reader, including on HTTP LAN hosts.
guide.galleryInsideAConfiguredWritableLibrary: Gallery, inside a configured writable library
guide.useTheFileManagementIconBesideSelectToRe: Use the file-management icon beside Select to reveal or hide Cut, Copy, Paste, Rename, Delete, New folder and Upload. Select media or folder checkboxes, choose Cut or Copy, browse into a destination folder, then Paste. The clipboard survives folder navigation; cut clears after successful queueing, while copy remains available. Ctrl/Cmd+X, C and V and Delete work while file management is open, outside text fields and dialogs. Paste stays within the source library. Upload, Move and Copy ask you to Replace or Skip an existing destination, for one item or all remaining conflicts in that batch. Replace moves the previous item and its contents to the recycle bin; it does not merge folder contents. Temporary path reservations wait automatically and can be cancelled. Rename works for one selected file or folder and asks for its new name. The expanded viewer menu also offers Rename and Delete; deletion advances to the next item, or the previous one at the end, and closes only when none remain. File management also works in search and tag results; open a destination folder to paste, upload or create a folder. New folder asks for a name in the current folder. Delete recycles by default and queues immediately after confirmation; progress and failures appear in Background jobs. Permanent deletion must be explicitly selected. Read-only libraries disable the file-management icon.
guide.theUploadDialogHasChooseFilesChooseFolde: The upload dialog has Choose files, Choose folder and a drag-and-drop area. Dropped folders keep their hierarchy. Uploads continue after closing the dialog; follow progress in Background jobs. Reselect matching files after a browser refresh to resume saved offsets. Existing destinations are never overwritten. Publication indexes only new files, without rescanning thousands of siblings.
guide.restoreOrPermanentlyRemoveRecycledItems: Restore or permanently remove recycled items
guide.chooseAWritableLibraryShowsOriginalPaths: Choose a writable library. Shows original paths and deletion dates. Restore returns an item to its original path; use an alternative relative path if that location is occupied. Restore never overwrites another file. Permanently delete asks for confirmation. Automatic retention cleanup is not available yet; recycled files consume media-volume space. The recycle bin is not a backup.
guide.backgroundJobsAnOperationNeedingAttentio: Background jobs → an operation needing attention
guide.reviewSourceStagingAndDestinationEvidenc: Review source, staging and destination evidence, then explicitly choose a supported recovery action. A missing mount or collision keeps the operation reserved until resolved. Do not remove internal staging folders or journal rows to clear it.

guide.besideTheFolderOrGalleryActionsButton: Beside the folder or gallery actions button
guide.showsACheckboxOnEachThumbnailSelectUpTo: Shows a checkbox on each thumbnail. Select up to 500 items at a time; use Select all to select the current results.
guide.selectionBarOnceItemsAreSelected: Selection bar, once items are selected

guide.foldersFollowTheSelectedDirectionDateSor: Folders follow the selected direction. Date sorts order folders by when each folder last changed on disk; every other sort orders them by name, with numbers in order (Day 2 before Day 10) and letter case and accents ignored.
guide.refreshCollectionOnlyReloadsWhatLumaHasA: Refresh collection only reloads what Luma has already indexed. Rescan folder (or Rescan library) reads the files on disk again and always asks first.
guide.hidingTheActiveFilterRowOnlyHidesItUse: Hiding the active-filter row only hides it. Use Clear all filters to actually widen the results.
guide.findMediaTagItAndMarkFavourites: Find media, tag it and mark favourites

guide.searchesFileNamesFoldersAndTagsWithinThe: Searches file names, folders and tags within the current filters. Inside a folder it covers that folder and its subfolders.
guide.belowTheSearchFieldAsYouType: Below the search field as you type
guide.completesTagsFoldersAndFileNamesFromYour: Completes tags, folders and file names from your whole library, each marked Tag, Folder or File with where it lives. A tag shows everything with exactly that tag; a folder or file opens it. Press Enter without choosing to search the typed text.
guide.phoneSearchStartsCollapsedSearchFiltersA: Phone search starts collapsed. Search, Filters and Settings are grouped on the right. Tap Open search to replace the logo and actions with an input on the same header row; Close search restores the normal header without clearing your query. Suggestions open below the header at its full content width, so they are not squeezed by the other buttons. Desktop search stays visible.
guide.deleteTheTextWithYourKeyboardAndSubmitTh: Delete the text with your keyboard and submit the empty field to clear the search and return to the folder you searched from, or to the empty Search page. The cross on phones closes search without clearing your text.
guide.tagsInMediaDetailsTheFlickTagsSheetAnd: Tags in Media details, the Flick Tags sheet and bulk Edit tags
guide.matchingTagsListBelowTheFieldAsYouType: Matching tags list below the field as you type; tap one to add it (tags already on the item show Added). Create “…” adds a new tag, as does pressing Enter.
guide.tagListForTheOpenItem: Tag list for the open item
guide.removesThatTagFromThisItemOnly: Removes that tag from this item only.
guide.chooseAddATagOrRemoveATagThen: Choose Add a tag or Remove a tag, then apply it to every selected item.
guide.actionRowInTheViewerAndFlickAndMedia: Action row in the viewer and Flick, and Media details
guide.marksTheItemAsAFavouritePressAgainTo: Marks the item as a favourite; press again to return it to unrated. Liked thumbnails show a small heart.
guide.marksTheItemAsDislikedPressAgainToReturn: Marks the item as disliked; press again to return it to unrated. Disliked items still appear unless you filter them out.
guide.showsOnlyFavouritesHiddenDislikedOrUnrat: Shows only Favourites, Hidden (disliked) or Unrated items.
guide.listsYourFavouritesAndEveryTagOpeningItS: Lists your favourites and every tag. Opening it starts from no filters.
guide.showsEveryItemWithThatTagPressAndHold: Shows every item with that tag. Press and hold to manage the tag.
guide.renameTheTagRenamingToAnotherTagSName: Rename the tag (renaming to another tag’s name merges them) or delete it from every item after confirming.
guide.likeAndDislikeAreTogglesAHighlightedHear: Like and Dislike are toggles: a highlighted heart means the state is on, and pressing it again clears it.
guide.openAFileNavigateViewDetailsAndPlayVideo: Open a file, navigate, view details and play video
guide.startsOrPausesASlideshowPhotosAdvanceOnA: Starts or pauses a slideshow. Photos advance on a timer, videos when they end, and it stops at the last item.
guide.cyclesThrough3510And20SecondsPer: Cycles through 3, 5, 10 and 20 seconds per photo. Remembered on this device.
guide.returnsToTheLastItemViewedInTheCurrent: Returns to the last item viewed in the current Gallery results, scrolling it into view and restoring keyboard focus. If you did not navigate, the original scroll position stays unchanged. Deep navigation loads a bounded page window directly rather than walking the entire collection.
guide.bottomRightBesideLikeAndDislike: Bottom right, beside Like and Dislike
guide.opensOrClosesTheMenuOfActionsAboveIt: Opens or closes the menu of actions above it.
guide.fitOrFillZoomActualSizeRotatePlaybackSpe: Fit or fill, zoom, actual size, rotate, playback speed, picture in picture, fullscreen, download and stream URL.
guide.confirmRecyclingOfTheDisplayedPhotoOrVid: Confirm recycling of the displayed photo or video, or explicitly select permanent deletion. The operation is queued and the viewer advances to the next item, or the previous one at the end; it closes only when no items remain. Flick offers the same action in its three-dot menu. Follow progress in Background jobs. Read-only libraries disable deletion, and the action is hidden when file management is off.
guide.likeAndDislikeTagsCoverChoicesMetadataIm: Like and Dislike, tags, cover choices, metadata import and export, and file information.
guide.viewerMenuForVideosAndGIFs: Viewer menu, for videos and GIFs
guide.continuesInFlickStartingAtThisItemWithTh: Continues in Flick starting at this item, with the same folder and filters.
guide.movesThroughTheCurrentResultsInTheirSort: Moves through the current results in their sorted order.
guide.showsTheWholeItemOrFillsTheScreenAnd: Shows the whole item, or fills the screen and crops the edges. Remembered on this device.
guide.zoomOutResetZoomZoomIn: Zoom out, reset zoom, zoom in
guide.theAndButtonsZoomThePercentageReturnsToF: The − and + buttons zoom; the percentage returns to fit.
guide.loadsTheOriginalFileAndShowsItPixelFor: Loads the original file and shows it pixel for pixel.
guide.turnsThePicture90OnScreenOnlyTheFile: Turns the picture 90° on screen only; the file is not changed.
guide.viewOptionsAndTheVideoControlBar: View options, and the video control bar
guide.fillsTheScreenControlsFadeWhileMediaPlay: Fills the screen. Controls fade while media plays and return when you move or tap.
guide.topRightInFullscreenOrTheVideoControlBar: Top right in fullscreen, or the video control bar
guide.copiesTheVideoSAddressForVLCOrAnother: Copies the video’s address for VLC or another network-stream player. Use it when this browser cannot play the format; originals are streamed without conversion.
guide.videoPlaybackBarAboveItOnSmallerScreensL: Video playback bar (above it on smaller screens); lower left in Flick
guide.turnsCaptionsOnOrOffForTheCurrentVideo: Turns captions on or off for the current video. Captions are off by default. Luma does no subtitle discovery, extraction or conversion until you turn CC on. It discovers matching external SRT and embedded SubRip/SRT, then prepares only the selected track. Caption settings lets you choose among available tracks. Turning CC off removes the track and cancels pending discovery without stopping playback.
guide.besideCCAfterCaptionsAreEnabled: Beside CC after captions are enabled
guide.forMovieMkvOrMovieMp4PlaceMovieSrt: For movie.mkv or movie.mp4, place movie.srt in the same folder; .SRT is also recognized. Language-suffixed files such as movie.en.srt and subtitles in other folders are not matched. Embedded tracks must actually use the SubRip/SRT codec. ASS/SSA, PGS/VobSub image subtitles, MP4 mov_text and other codecs are not supported; there is no OCR or automatic subtitle generation. SRT text must be UTF-8 or BOM-marked UTF-16, up to 4 MiB.
guide.stylizedSubtitlesAreNotSupportedAuthorFo: Stylized subtitles are not supported. Author fonts, colors, bold/italic markup, positioning and effects are discarded; captions use the browser’s plain presentation above the playback bar. Extracted SRT, converted WebVTT and all temporary subtitle files stay in the configured Luma cache directory, never beside originals. Cached captions are reused until the source changes or the bounded caption cache evicts them. Preparation errors leave playback available; turn CC off and on to retry.
guide.leftOfTheVideoControlBar: Left of the video control bar
guide.dragOrTapToJumpToATimeThe: Drag or tap to jump to a time. The lighter part shows what has loaded.
guide.silencesTheVideoOrRestoresItsVolume: Silences the video or restores its volume.
guide.setsTheVolumeInFineSteps: Sets the volume in fine steps.
guide.whenOnTheNextVideoStartsByItselfWhen: When on, the next video starts by itself when the current one ends. Luma remembers the choice. Flick uses its own Auto-scroll instead.
guide.videoControlBarViewOptionsOnUprightPhone: Video control bar (View options on upright phones)
Video control bar (View options on upright phones), where the browser supports it
guide.popsTheVideoIntoASmallFloatingWindow: Pops the video into a small floating window.
guide.overAVideoYouLeftPartWayThrough: Over a video you left part-way through
guide.carriesOnFromWhereYouStoppedOrStartsAgai: Carries on from where you stopped, or starts again from 0:00.
guide.mediaDetailsAndMediaInformationInFlick: Media details, and Media information in Flick
guide.readsThisFileSEmbeddedEXIFXMPTagsInto: Reads this file’s embedded EXIF/XMP tags into Luma. Tick Include adjacent XMP sidecars to read a matching .xmp file too.
guide.preparesADownloadOfThisItemSTagsAs: Prepares a download of this item’s tags as XMP; Download export appears when it is ready.
guide.marksAVideoGIFsShowAGIFBadgeInstead: Marks a video. GIFs show a GIF badge instead.
guide.alongTheBottomOfAVideoThumbnail: Along the bottom of a video thumbnail
guide.noBarMeansUnwatchedAPartialBarMeansIn: No bar means unwatched, a partial bar means in progress, and a full bar means watched.
guide.theItemIsOneOfYourFavourites: The item is one of your favourites.
guide.watchProgressIsSavedOnThisLumaServerSo: Watch progress is saved on this Luma server, so every browser and device using it shares the same progress. It is not a per-person account sync.
guide.resumeAppearsInTheNormalViewerOnlyFlickA: Resume appears in the normal viewer only; Flick always starts a video from the beginning.
guide.fullScreenVerticalBrowsingOfVideosAndGIF: Full-screen vertical browsing of videos and GIFs
guide.opensFlickWithItsOwnSavedFiltersSwitchin: Opens Flick with its own saved filters. Switching applications does not copy Gallery filters; the viewer’s Watch on Flick action deliberately carries the current item and context. Without a media type filter Flick shows videos and GIFs.
guide.opensOrClosesTheFlickActions: Opens or closes the Flick actions.
guide.opensFiltersAndSortingForFlickTheHeaderS: Opens Filters and sorting for Flick. The header search field works like Gallery, with inline tag/folder/file suggestions restricted to videos. Enter applies a video search; choosing a suggestion stays in Flick. Panels uses the same header with comic-title suggestions only.
guide.hidesOrShowsTheActiveFilterRowWithoutCle: Hides or shows the active-filter row without clearing any filter. This choice applies to Flick only; Library and Search keep their own.
guide.flickStartMutedYourChoiceIsRememberedOnT: Flick start muted; your choice is remembered on this device.
guide.whenOnMovesToTheNextReelWhenA: When on, moves to the next reel when a video ends, or after 3 seconds on a photo. When off, videos loop.
guide.addsOrRemovesTagsOnTheCurrentReel: Adds or removes tags on the current reel.
guide.fitOrFillOpenInViewerVolumeSliderPlaybac: Fit or fill, Open in viewer, volume slider, playback speed, picture in picture, fullscreen, download and stream URL.
guide.fileInformationPlusMetadataImportAndXMPE: File information plus metadata import and XMP export for this reel.
guide.movesToThePreviousOrNextReel: Moves to the previous or next reel.
guide.opensTheCurrentReelInTheNormalViewerWith: Opens the current reel in the normal viewer with its full video controls.
guide.tapTheBottomStripOfAVideoReel: Tap the bottom strip of a video reel
guide.revealsTheSeekBarForAFewSecondsThe: Reveals the seek bar for a few seconds; the first touch only reveals it, so playback never jumps by accident.
guide.watchOnFlickInTheViewerStartsAtThe: Watch on Flick in the viewer starts at the item you were viewing and keeps your folder and explicit filters.
guide.flickHasAVolumeSliderInViewOptionsBut: Flick has a volume slider in View options but no right-side volume swipe: vertical swipes always move between reels.
guide.flickRemembersWhereYouWereForTheSameSet: Flick remembers where you were for the same set of filters.
guide.opensTheJobsListStartARescanFromA: Opens the jobs list. Start a rescan from a folder or library card’s Folder actions menu.

guide.stopsTheTaskWorkAlreadyFinishedSuchAsPre: Stops the task. Work already finished, such as prepared previews and imported tags, is kept. Indexing asks first: folders you open afterwards are finished then, including their tags if the library imports tags.
guide.onACancelledFailedOrInterruptedTask: On a cancelled, failed or interrupted task

guide.onAnyTaskThatIsNoLongerActive: On any task that is no longer active
guide.removesThatOneEntryFromTheList: Removes that one entry from the list.

guide.eachTaskShowsWhatItIsIndexingTagImport: Each task shows what it is (indexing, tag import, XMP export or disliked paths export), its state (queued, running, completed, cancelled, failed or interrupted) and its progress.
guide.interruptedMeansLumaStoppedTheTaskForExa: Interrupted means Luma stopped the task, for example on restart. An interrupted or cancelled task stops at once and never picks up again by itself.
guide.clearFinishedOnlyTidiesTheListItDoesNot: Clear finished only tidies the list. It does not delete media, scan history or metadata checkpoints.
guide.finishedJobsClearThemselvesOnceThereAreM: Finished jobs clear themselves once there are more than ten of a kind, so the list stays short without any tidying.
guide.cancellingStopsFurtherWorkItDoesNotUndoC: Cancelling stops further work; it does not undo changes a task has already made.
guide.updatesThemeAlbumCoversRandomMediaLinksE: Updates, theme, album covers, random media links, exports, library tag import and hidden folders
guide.useEnableFileManagementInSettingsGeneral: Use Enable file management in Settings → General. No administrator token is required. The saved server switch overrides the Luma__Files__Enabled environment default. Each editable library also needs Writable=true and a :rw mount. Failed mount checks disable write actions for that library; browsing, playback, captions and tagging continue. Correct permissions and use Check media mounts to restore file changes.
guide.gearButtonInTheTopHeader: Gear button in the top header
guide.opensSettingsYourCurrentFiltersStayInPla: Opens Settings. Your current filters stay in place for when you return.
guide.showsTheReleaseThisDeviceIsRunningWhenTh: Shows the release this device is running. When the server has a newer one, Refresh to update loads it; Luma also offers that once, in a small message you can close.
guide.listsWhatChangedInThisReleaseItOpensBy: Lists what changed in this release. It opens by itself the first time you load a new version.
guide.choosesLumaSColoursOnThisDevice: Chooses Luma’s colours on this device.
guide.smartCoversShowAMosaicForAlbumsWithThree: Smart covers show a mosaic for albums with three or more photos and fit single photos to the card; Cropped covers fill the card with one photo. Covers you picked yourself keep their photo either way.
guide.choosesTheOrderFlickOpensInOnThisDevice: Chooses the order Flick opens in on this device, such as Shuffle for a new feed each visit. Gallery and Flick retain independent filters and ordering when you switch applications.
guide.buildsAReusableLinkThatReturnsARandomCac: Builds a reusable link that returns a random cached photo or GIF preview matching your current browsing filters. It does not serve random videos.
guide.preparesDownloadsOfYourTagsAsXMPOrA: Prepares downloads of your tags as XMP, or a list of disliked file paths. Download export appears when ready.
guide.choosesWatcherPeriodicScanOrManualDiscov: Chooses watcher, periodic-scan or manual discovery per library, refresh-on-open behavior, debounce and stability timing, and the separate embedded/XMP tag-import mode. Tag choices do not affect thumbnails or previews.
guide.bringsAHiddenFolderBackIntoBrowsingAndIn: Brings a hidden folder back into browsing and indexing.
guide.showsTheInstalledLumaVersionProjectLinkA: Shows the installed Luma version, project link and creator credit. The version also appears at the bottom-left of desktop navigation.
guide.metadataImportsAreStartedFromAFolderFold: Metadata imports are started from a folder (Folder actions → Import folder metadata) or from a single file (Media details → Import metadata tags), not from Settings.
guide.zoomsInOrOutDragToPanWhileZoomed: Zooms in or out; drag to pan while zoomed.
guide.photosAndGIFsInTheViewer: Photos and GIFs in the viewer
guide.zoomsIntoTheTappedSpotDoubleTapAgainTo: Zooms into the tapped spot; double-tap again to return to fit.
guide.playsOrPausesInFullscreenWithHiddenContr: Plays or pauses. In fullscreen with hidden controls, the first tap only shows them.
guide.videosInTheViewerAndFlick: Videos in the viewer and Flick
guide.playsAt2UntilYouLetGo: Plays at 2× until you let go.
guide.swipeUpOrDownOnTheRightSide: Swipe up or down on the right side
guide.videosInTheNormalViewerOnly: Videos in the normal viewer only
guide.raisesOrLowersTheVolumeWithABriefVolume: Raises or lowers the volume, with a brief volume readout.
guide.checksTheFolderInViewForNewChangedAnd: Checks the folder in view for new, changed and removed files, using the library’s tag-import setting. It reads that one folder, not the folders inside it: Rescan folder covers those. While a scan is already running, this folder moves to the front of it.
guide.nextOrPreviousReelMouseWheelAndTrackpadS: Next or previous reel. Mouse wheel and trackpad scrolling do the same.
guide.openMediaDetailsWithTheTagFieldReady: Open media details with the tag field ready
guide.zoomAPhotoInOrOut: Zoom a photo in or out
guide.closeTheTopPanelThenTheViewer: Close the top panel, then the viewer
guide.backOrForward5SecondsInAVideo: Back or forward 5 seconds in a video
guide.deploymentPreferenceKeys: Use Luma__Ui__Preferences__ followed by the exact preference key. Values are strings; JSON preferences use a quoted JSON object. Saved choices in the app take precedence. Supported keys: luma-theme, luma-appearance-v2, luma-album-covers, luma-reels-sort, luma-slideshow-seconds, luma-video-autoplay, luma-viewer-fill, luma-reels-fill, luma-show-filters, luma-reels-show-filters, luma-reels-state, luma-panels-reader-defaults. Boolean keys accept true/false or 1/0; JSON booleans use true or false. Reader defaults apply to comics without saved preferences.
